description: Append one item to a binder you own (requires an lp_ API key). Pass exactly one of slug (a lucid.page page) or url (any http(s) link), plus an optional title (links only) and note.

note.description: Optional note shown with the item.

slug.description: A lucid.page page slug: one of your own pages, or anyone's public or unlisted page.

title.description: Optional display title for a link.

url.description: An http(s) link. Links to lucid.page pages are stored as those pages.

name: add_to_binder
title: Add a page or link to a binder
